title: Topological Effects on Bubbling in the Critical Dirichlet Problem on Hyperbolic Domains: $3\leq N \leq5$
summary: Let \(Ω\Subset\mathbb H^N\), \(N\in\{3,4,5\}\), be a bounded connected \(C^2\) domain. We prove that the pure critical Dirichlet problem \[ -Δ_{\mathbb H}u=u^{\frac{N+2}{N-2}} \quad\text{in }Ω, \qquad u=0 \quad\text{on }\partialΩ \] admits a positive solution whenever \(H_d(Ω;\mathbb F_2)\neq0\) for some \(1\le d\le N-1\). This gives a hyperbolic Bahri-Coron theorem for \(3\le N\le5\) under \(C^2\) boundary regularity.
